scope: Windows x64 synthetic registered mode-1 party: original-DLL status, full result CSV and cumulative journal comparisons, actual damage, first-wave victory, registered next wave and second-wave victory. Twelve cases cover 1/3/5 contiguous packed effects and incoming enemy types 0/1/2/3, changed enemy HP, failure/pending-output priorities and short/null result reads. The actual Unity runtime NativeRegisteredBattle.cs adapter is also compiled and executed against the rebuilt Windows DLL in three two-wave scenarios; 108 result/journal comparisons match the original and repeated disposal/creation does not exhaust catalog capacity. No Unity engine, ARM64, real game resources, account state or iPhone execution was tested.
